name: collab-editor-monorepo
description: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor (Mini VS Code Live Share / Replit)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "CLIENT,SERVER,RUNNER" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:runner"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=runner && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.sandbox:build: docker build -t collab-sandbox-python:latest -f docker/sandbox/python.Dockerfile docker/sandbox && docker build -t collab-sandbox-node:latest -f docker/sandbox/node.Dockerfile docker/sandbox && docker build -t collab-sandbox-java:latest -f docker/sandbox/java.Dockerfile docker/sandbox && docker build -t collab-sandbox-cpp:latest -f docker/sandbox/cpp.Dockerfile docker/sandbox
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=runner

author: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
